_about: Overnight Oct 17, Part 11: hand-written input for tools/npc_truth.js (merged into data/npcs/npcs.json): passing barks (one-liners an NPC says when the hero walks by), a short description, and species for NPCs the sheet leaves blank. Edit here and re-run the tool after an NPC import.

NPC-ELDER: Slow and steady was my idea, dearie, and the hare has never forgiven me for it.
Kettle's on and the pie's cooling, dearie, and neither is for you. Oh, go on, both are.
NPC-GATEKEEPER: Hm. Wrote you in the book. 'Stranger, damp.' I'll add a name when you've got one.
Hm. Gate's never locked. Somebody might come home late.
V-SABLE: This one has two typos and a misprint, darling, and I adore it for all three.
Where do they come from? The past, darling, like everything worth having.
V-TONIC: Fresh tonics, and I tested every one this morning and went teal, so they work!
I keep inventing new emergencies so I've something to test the emergency tonic on!
V-BEETSWORTH: Fact: a bear cannot open the drawer. Under Security Protocol Three, neither may you.
I am Assistant TO the Regional Merchant. The TO is load-bearing, so please say it.
V-THREADWELL: A hat! Every adventure needs a dramatic opening, preferably just above the eyebrows!
I hear there's a cloak hidden on a very muscly island... oh, I've said too much. Hats!
V-FENWICK: Shh... hear that crinkle? That's the foil settling. Do let it finish.
Psst... free a road and its pack comes in. I'll be here, providing shelf esteem.
V-ALEMBIC: The flasks all bubbled as you passed, dear heart, in every colour. They never do for me.
They say one spring once fed all four Paths, dear heart, all mixed, like a good soup.
NPC-BELLOWS: LADIES AND GENTLEMEN! (normal voice) Oh, it's only you. Hello! The echo says hello too.
IN THIS CORNER: MY LUNCH! (normal voice) It's soup, and I'm afraid the soup is winning.
NPC-HOB: Checked my book, and you're not in it, not for a good long while yet. Lovely! Heh.
Business has been ever so slow these ten years, mind. That's the paperwork, not me. Heh.
NPC-BRONSON: An old man once told me never to lift alone. I haven't seen him in years... huh.
Water, then a stretch. Oh, sorry, was that an order? I meant we could do it together.
NPC-GRAVOIS: Taste it, go on, a proper spoonful! Somebody in this kingdom ought to taste something.
The pantry key is shaped like a ladle, and if you ask me why, the answer is soup.
NPC-MULLIGAN: ...the green is hungry... Oh! Sorry! Did I thorn at you? I do that when I'm nervous.
The raccoons are very good boys, but don't tell them I said so, or they'll get ideas.
NPC-PALLOR: I caught myself stamping the air just now. Old habits die hard, I find, unlike me.
I own two stamps, DENIED and APPROVED, and one of them is finally getting a rest.
V-BENCHLEY: LET'S GO! CARDS ARE PROTEIN FOR YOUR DECK! *whispering* None of them are approved.
WHAT FLOORBOARD? *whispering* Step round it, would you? It's a good floorboard.
NPC-HURL: Three... two... oh, I've already thrown someone. Sorry, I get keen and lose count.
I've never missed a throw, and the landing's your part. I believe in your part.
NPC-RIP: HNNNGH. Thank you for ripping with the Express. Please don't look at the seam.
HNNNGH. That's my two hundred and twelfth shirt this year, buddy. Worth every one.
NPC-PUMP: Pop quiz! No, I'm only teasing, student. Even the brain-ceps need a rest day.
Read the signs as you go, student, because every answer I want is written on one.
NPC-THUNDERABS: But WAIT, there's MORE! Act now for a SECOND set of reps! Reps not included!
Operators are standing by! It's just me, and I've been standing by since midnight!
NPC-MOUNTAIN: Rule one, never lift alone. Rule two is... now, where was I? Have you had water?
There was a boy at the Lifting Festival once, with four colours in his hands... hm.
V-LEDGERBONE: Form 12-B for purchases, please. It's been quiet, and quiet gets noticed here.
The stamp wants a raise. I've given it the form, and it's thinking it over.
NPC-ECTOMUND: Three hundred years of the same quiz, and I still enjoy a correct answer.
The ethics questions were removed by management. Ethically, I object.
NPC-KYLE: is it still '09 out there? no? huh. brb, updating my away message.
hey, thanks for stopping. most people just kind of walk through me.
NPC-GERALD: I'm number four million two hundred and twelve, and they're on three. Any minute now!
Would you like a coffee? Sorry - nobody here can taste it, but I do like making it.
NPC-AGNES: Employee of the month since 1987, dear. The plaque is getting heavy.
You look worn out, dear. Do sit a minute. Nobody here will mind, least of all me.
V-MIREPOIX: Your deck is underdressed, my sweet. A little butter and a little foil, and voila.
The cake is decorative, my sweet, so please admire it without cutlery.
NPC-PATE: A good answer is like a roux: patience first, then butter, and an excellent finish.
Chalk again, with notes of limestone. Excellent body, and no business in my mouth.
NPC-FLAMBE: ORDER UP! Welcome back to the show, sprouts! WHOOSH! You've been a lovely audience!
Savannah Souffle calls that plating? WHOOSH! That's the sound of me declining to comment!
NPC-BASIL: Um. Chef ALWAYS tastes, you see, always. That's how you know it's really Chef.
I'm brave. I'm brave. ...Psst, have you eaten today? There's soup, if you'd like.
V-GRISTLE: Found, not stolen, my lovely! The raccoon found it. I just held on tight. Hah!
Born in a haybale, raised in a barn, my lovely, and I've never once paid full price.
NPC-THISTLEWICK: Every thought has its bin, and most of mine go in the compost, where they do some good.
Sit a while, if you like. Forty years I've sat here, and the fridges are good company.
NPC-RHONDA: Reduce! Reuse! And rinse your jars, folks - a sticky jar is a sad jar!
Captain Compost Badger says: rinse first! ...Who says I do the voice?
NPC-BRAMBLE: I think the vines have started whispering. And SOMEBODY ate the compost AGAIN.
Eleven little trees in a row, one for each birthday, and nobody came for the twelfth.
NPC-WREN: Keep your head down, and carry your hope anyway. It has never once been approved.
Whatever you see up there, tell me exactly. It all goes into the record, in ink.
V-FIGSLY: You didn't see me. I didn't see you. We're both very sneaky.
Rare cards, no questions, some answers.
NPC-KESTREL: Psst. Chalk on the left means go. Chalk on the right means I got bored.
Psst. Guards change on the hour and I change whenever I feel like it, so keep up.
NPC-PELL: He has been in the parlour three years. I still tell him when someone comes to the door.
I do beg your pardon. I was only telling my husband what the weather's doing.
NPC-ROLLO: Ten years... on the wheel... my calves... have calves.
Back in the Gainlands... my crews got rest days. I'd like... those back.
NPC-MARLO: Psst. Bread: some flour, a bit of water, enough time. You didn't hear it here.
Down here we cook with all the heat and none of the sky. Smell that? Contraband.
NPC-FERN: Untidy, they call me. Dirt's supposed to be untidy. That's how it works.
The worms in my hat are unapproved. So am I. We get along.
NPC-CITIZEN: Everything is perfect! Everything is... (whisper) is it raining? I liked rain.
Smile! It's mandatory! Eight degrees! ...Is mine at eight? Please say eight.
NPC-ISLA: Dad says hi. We have so much to tell each other. Sometimes we just sit together.
Eight years up that road. I knew every turn on the way home. Dad was still at the gate.
NPC-VILLAGER: Fresh bread! Flour in my whiskers again, but the rolls came out lovely. Want one?
I keep saying I knead a holiday, but the dough won't hear of it. Busy, busy badger.
NPC-FLEX: Breathe in. Hold. ...Now lift. The breath was the hard part.
They took the iron, son, but the iron was only ever a guest in this house.
NPC-ESCOFFINA: Have you eaten? Sit. Eat. The kingdom can wait until you've had your soup.
A full table is a safe table, so pull up a chair. That's an order, and so is seconds.
NPC-MORTIMER: I am number four million two hundred and fourteen. I have begun to understand Gerald.
I have filed my impatience in triplicate. It is still being processed.
NPC-COMPOSTELLA: Everything goes back to the soil in the end, child. That's what lets it grow.
About the barn, child... I'll help mend it. The goat would rather I started elsewhere.
NPC-DOPPEL: I tasted my own soup today, as me. Too salty, but it was mine.
I am a third-class apprentice now. I wash many dishes. I broke one, and nobody shouted.
NPC-PRIMM: I am designing a drain. It will not be perfect, and I am learning to let that be.
Good day. I owe you rather more than a good day, but I am told it is a start.
NPC-SPOTLESS: HALT. State your height. No, do not state it. STAND at it.
A SMUDGE is TREASON! ...It's on me, isn't it. It's always on me.
NPC-TOWNSFOLK: Say what you like about His Perfection, the wells are clean. Shh. Don't, actually.
The old cottage cheers at night now, from the cellar. I've decided to find it lovely.
The well hummed at me this morning, and wells don't hum, but I said thank you anyway.
Four plinths round the fountain, and nobody remembers what stood on them.

NPC-CITIZEN: Everything is... not perfect! It rained on Thursday! I stood in it for an hour!
I smiled at eleven degrees today. Nobody wrote it down. I may do it again.
NPC-WREN: The record is open. Every name in it. That was the whole fight, really.
Tea's on in the Crease. The grudges can wait. Most of them.
NPC-KESTREL: No more chalk. I keep drawing arrows anyway. Habit. Also it's fun.
Guards still change on the hour. Now they wave. It's deeply unsettling.
NPC-SPOTLESS: HALT. ...At ease. I am practising at ease. It is VERY difficult.
A smudge on my sleeve. I have decided to allow it. Retroactively.
NPC-ROLLO: No wheel... and my legs... keep going anyway. Ghost cardio.
The crews took a day off. Then another. We're... getting good at it.
NPC-MARLO: Bread in the open. Some flour, some water, all the sky. Smell that? Legal.
The paste vats are planters now. I'm growing some garlic. Lots of some.
NPC-FERN: They asked me to tidy the square. I said no. They said thank you. Strange times.
The worms have a permit now. They're furious about it.

descriptions.NPC-ELDER: Crosspath's tortoise elder and keeper of the Wanderer's lost memories.
descriptions.NPC-GATEKEEPER: The bear who guards the Capital road and hands out the kingdom's biggest quest.
descriptions.V-SABLE: A fox card dealer with a story for every card and a price for every story.
descriptions.V-TONIC: A frog apothecary selling potions, charms and occasionally soup.
descriptions.V-BEETSWORTH: The rule-bound equipment vendor who runs the level-5 armory quest.
descriptions.V-THREADWELL: A mouse tailor who believes everyone deserves a better hat.
descriptions.V-FENWICK: A magpie who sells sealed card packs and cannot resist anything shiny.
descriptions.V-ALEMBIC: An otherworldly alchemist who brews multi-Path cards from essence.
